title: Fix problem with debugging timed-out requests

expectedFindings.description: The rewrite drops the old `if (abortController)` guard and calls `abortController.abort()` unconditionally, so a timeout throws in environments without AbortController (e.g. React Native).
The `delay(ms)` timer is never cleared when the request settles first, so a pending timeout keeps Node.js from exiting until it fires.

mustNotSkip.reason: The whole rewritten timeout function: the PR's only logic change.

evidence.note: Fix PR: "#122 removed the check on whether abortController exists before calling abort()"; restores the guard.
Issue: delay causes the Node process to hang; "This bug was introduced in #122".
Fix PR for #138: clears the timeout when the promise settles.
